name: llm-wiki
description: Persistent, compounding knowledge base — LLM incrementally builds and maintains a structured wiki

scripts.build:check: node esbuild.config.mjs production && node -e "const m=require('./manifest.json');if(!m.id||!m.version)throw new Error('Invalid manifest')"
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json

author: LLM Wiki
